definitions.explanation: A division of a university focused on a particular field of study.

examples.japanese: {経済|けいざい}学部で{学|まな}んでいる。
examples.english: I'm studying in the economics department.

notes:
～{学部|がくぶ} is a suffix attached to a field of study to indicate a university faculty or department.

COMMON FACULTIES:
- {文|ぶん}{学部|がくぶ}: faculty of literature
- {経済|けいざい}{学部|がくぶ}: faculty of economics
- {工|こう}{学部|がくぶ}: faculty of engineering
- {法|ほう}{学部|がくぶ}: faculty of law
- {医|い}{学部|がくぶ}: faculty of medicine
- {理|り}{学部|がくぶ}: faculty of science
- {教育|きょういく}{学部|がくぶ}: faculty of education

PATTERNS:
- ～{学部|がくぶ}に{入|はい}る: to enter a faculty
- ～{学部|がくぶ}を{卒業|そつぎょう}する: to graduate from a faculty
- ～{学部|がくぶ}の{学生|がくせい}: a student in the ~ faculty

RELATED:
- {学科|がっか}: department (subdivision within a faculty)
- {大学院|だいがくいん}: graduate school
- {研究科|けんきゅうか}: graduate school division
